dataset: Official baby-name top 100, latest verified releases
selection: Top 100 by published rank; ties at or above rank 100 retained. Names are source spellings. Same names are separate observations for each jurisdiction and are never deduplicated across datasets.

schema.rank: Official rank (1-based), read from the source rank field/list; source rank may tie.
schema.rank_tied: True when multiple entries share this rank in the same jurisdiction/year/sex source list.
schema.name: Name exactly as supplied by source.
schema.count: Official count when published; null when unavailable or suppressed.
schema.sex: male/female as categorized by the official source.

same_name_handling: No cross-jurisdiction deduplication. The same spelling in different countries/jurisdictions remains a separate observation under each source.

unavailable.status: Not extracted: official page and ZIP returned HTTP 403 to both browser fetch and curl, including a retried download. No nonofficial mirror or substitute was used.
